verdict.rationale: Missive publishes a complete REST API endpoint reference with per-endpoint example requests against the live /v1 base URL, served as raw Markdown and indexed in llms.txt, which AI tools can consume. The evidence explicitly states there is no live try-it runner and no OpenAPI spec, and probes for OpenAPI paths all returned 404, so the 'interactive' part of the story is not delivered; the examples must be copied and run outside the docs. missing for 10: interactive in-browser try-it console, runnable-in-place examples, OpenAPI spec to drive interactive tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Complete reference for Missive API endpoints: analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels, and more
with per-endpoint example requests against https://public.missiveapp.com/v1/
